description: release-safety: a SessionStart reminder that appears once per project and only where CI or deploy configuration exists, and a PreToolUse hook on tag pushes, branch-plus-tag pushes, gh release create and remote tag deletes (reminder by default; opt-in ask mode asks you first).

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start_release_advisory.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/release_push_guard.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
